description: A dedicated server-only module boundary that centralizes session verification, authorization rules, database queries, and safe DTO projection.
A React API that deduplicates calls to an async or synchronous function with identical arguments within a single server request render pass.
A narrowed plain object returned by the DAL that includes only the fields safe for UI consumption, stripping secrets such as `passwordHash` or `supplierCost`.
Scoping memoized results to a single incoming HTTP request so that authenticated user or tenant state is never shared across different visitors.
A package import (`import 'server-only'`) that triggers a build-time error if any Client Component transitively imports a server-side DAL module.
